latin: Dato per impossibile quod daretur materia quae corruptionis principium non esset, adhuc si coelum ex tali materia et forma esset uere compositum, aeternum esse non posset.
translation: Suppose, per impossibile, that a matter existed which was not a principle of corruption: even then, if the heavens were genuinely composed from such matter and form, they could not be eternal.
